description: esp32DeviceLimits (frameos/wasm/src/devices.ts, its copy frontend/src/utils/deviceLimits.ts) and esp32_device_limits (backend/app/utils/device_limits.py): the wasm renderer ceiling for an ESP32 frame. `pixelFormat` (fos_pixel_format_t, default unknown): the panel's format, which decides its canvas — half a byte on a sixteen-grey panel (8), one byte of luma on another grey or black-and-white panel (1, 4) and RGB565 on any other (an RGB565 LCD, 9; a colour e-paper) whatever the PSRAM (a colour e-paper got RGBX while two of it fitted PSRAM until 2026.11.13). `canvasBytesPerPixel` is that canvas, which the wasm runtime draws in while it runs as the ESP32 (src/wasm/wasm_main.nim previewCanvas). `rotate` (default unknown): the frame's rotation, given only where its firmware draws a sixteen-grey scene in the panel buffer (`canvasRotation`: from ESP32_SHARED_CANVAS_FIRMWARE); at 0 on a sixteen-grey panel the canvas IS the panel buffer (the firmware's main.c canvas_is_panel_picture), and on a colour panel (5, 6, 7) with a 565 canvas the picture is packed into the canvas's first bytes (main.c canvas_holds_panel_picture, from ESP32_PACK_IN_CANVAS_FIRMWARE); then no separate packed buffer is charged. Replayed by cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/device-limits.test.ts and backend/app/utils/tests/test_device_limits.py.

cases.name: 7.3 inch on an 8 MB board: a 565 canvas (RGBX until 2026.11.13)
7.5 inch black and white on an 8 MB board: luma canvas, though RGBX fits
13.3 inch on an 8 MB board (the E1004): RGB565 canvas
the E1004 unturned on firmware that packs in the canvas: no panel buffer of its own
the E1004 turned 90 degrees: a turned pack, so a canvas and a panel buffer
7.3 inch Spectra 6 unturned on an 8 MB board: its picture packed in its 565 canvas
10.3 inch sixteen greys on an 8 MB board (the E1003), rotation not known: 4-bit canvas and a panel buffer
the E1003 unturned on firmware that shares: the panel buffer is the 4-bit canvas
the E1003 turned 90 degrees: a turned pack, so a canvas and a panel buffer
the same panel size in colour: RGB565 canvas
13.3 inch on a 16 MB board: a 565 canvas, as on 8 MB
a 2 MB board: the heap floor
the SenseCAP Indicator's 480x480 RGB565 LCD: a 565 canvas that is its own frame buffer
7.5 inch black and white unturned: a luma canvas is never the panel buffer
the Sunton 800x480 RGB565 LCD: three 768 KB frame buffers of its own
the SenseCAP Indicator's LCD unturned: its frame buffers are charged as before

canvasRotation.description: esp32CanvasRotation / esp32_canvas_rotation: the rotation the limits are given for a frame reporting `rotate` and running `firmwareVersion`; null (two buffers, the safe direction) on firmware older than ESP32_SHARED_CANVAS_FIRMWARE (ESP32_PACK_IN_CANVAS_FIRMWARE for a colour panel, `pixelFormat` 5 to 7) or one that does not say.
